description: This file implements the FrameTracker class for tracking frame timing and statistics in Android's SurfaceFlinger component, including methods for setting frame times, advancing frames, processing fences, and logging stats.

classes.name: FrameTracker
classes.description: Class for tracking frame presentation times, fences, and statistics in Android SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: setDesiredPresentTime
methods.description: Sets the desired presentation time for the current frame.

methods.name: setFrameReadyTime
methods.description: Sets the time when the frame is ready.

methods.name: setFrameReadyFence
methods.description: Associates a fence with the frame ready event.

methods.name: setActualPresentTime
methods.description: Sets the actual time the frame was presented.

methods.name: setActualPresentFence
methods.description: Associates a fence with the actual presentation event.

methods.name: advanceFrame
methods.description: Advances to the next frame, updating stats and clearing fences.

methods.name: logAndResetStats
methods.description: Logs current stats and resets counters.

methods.name: processFencesLocked
methods.description: Processes fences to update frame times based on fence signals.

methods.name: updateStatsLocked
methods.description: Updates frame timing statistics based on a new frame index.

methods.name: isFrameValidLocked
methods.description: Checks if a frame's data is valid.

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Dumps frame timing statistics into a string.
